NONE: › when considered in the stated way
› regularly after the stated period of time
› like the stated person or thing
› used for indicating one of a series of events that happen with the stated regular period of time between each
（指一系列事件在所述時間段定期發生）

example: Personally (= in my opinion), I don't think animals should be killed for their fur.
在我看來，我認為不應該為獲取毛皮而獵殺動物。
This is an environmentally (= in relation to the environment) disastrous proposal.
這個提案會對環境造成災難性的後果。
